summary: Session 73 frontend-only verification on https://finance-platform-v2.preview.emergentagent.com/ (Desktop 1920x800 + Mobile 390x844). Consent gate (Deutschland / Privatperson, US-Checkbox leer) closed successfully. ALL 6 requested refactoring features PASS: (1) IntersectionObserver impression tracking on #home-product-wizard fires product_inquiry_open exactly once per session (dataLayer count = 1 after first scroll, still 1 after scroll-away+back, 0 after same-session reload; sessionStorage 'product_wizard_inline_open_fired' = '1'); (2) Sticky CTA renders bottom-right (desktop x=1662,y=728; mobile x=16,y=698) and its popup renders all 6 catalog products with data-testid product-inquiry-option-<key>, each showing kicker/title/benefit from getProductCatalog() (no hardcoded copy); (3) Bonus badges render ONLY for tagesgeld + flexgeld (home-product-wizard-bonus-*), none for aktien/anleihen/fonds/festgeld; (4) Clicking a popup option and an inline card fires product_inquiry_select and opens the real wizard modal (role=dialog, 1/7 Kurzfragebogen); (5) Regression: 6 cards in grid (desktop 3 cols 352px each, mobile 1 col), no JS/SyntaxError, no 'PRODUCTS has already been declared'; (6) Console clean of app-level JS errors — only pre-existing 401 network errors and SVG-path warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: Bonus badge copy contradicts the product: Tagesgeld and Flexgeld cards render the BBVA summary text 'Willkommenspraemie auf das Festgeld ... garantierter Zinssatz ueber die gesamte Laufzeit' — i.e. Festgeld wording on Tagesgeld/Flexgeld cards. Mapping is technically per spec (bbva-bank-deutschland), but the rendered copy is product-inconsistent and misleading.

BANK_BONUS_COPY.summary is ~300 chars and rendered untruncated at 11.5px inside a narrow card column -> badge block becomes taller than the whole card content, breaks card height rhythm on desktop 3-col grid (see screenshot: Tagesgeld/Flexgeld cards visually 2x higher). Recommend a short badge line (e.g. bonus.short/headline) or line-clamp-2.

On 390x844 the sticky pill (and its popup) overlaps the 'Aktien im Fokus' interstitial card body/CTA. The nearForm avoidance guard only observes #home-newsletter, not the interstitial. Interstitial close button stays reachable, so not blocking.

integration_issues.issue: Event NAMES fire correctly, but the props are silently dropped: trackInvestmentEvent() whitelists only ['topic','topic_slug','placement','route','source_page','article_slug','position'], so {source:'inline_home'|'sticky_popup'} and {product:<key>} never reach gtag/dataLayer. Observed dataLayer payloads: {"event":"product_inquiry_open"} and {"event":"product_inquiry_select"} with no dimensions -> source/product attribution is impossible.

integration_issues.flow: Live market data (pre-existing, out of scope of session 73)
integration_issues.issue: Repeated 401 responses: /api/auth/me (anon, expected) and https://<supabase>/functions/v1/stock-history (401, ~15x per pageload). Consequence: 4x console error 'Error: <path> attribute d: Expected moveto path command (M or m), "undefined"' — sparkline components (MiniSparkline.jsx:57 / InterestRateSparkline.jsx:65) render d="undefined" when the history payload is empty. Needs a guard for empty data.

issues: Bonus badge text length makes Tagesgeld/Flexgeld cards significantly taller than sibling cards -> uneven grid rows
Popup (max-h 78vh) top area with 'Produktwahl' header sits under/near the fixed site header on short viewports; the 6th option (Flexgeld) requires in-popup scrolling

action_items: Add 'source' and 'product' to the allowed props whitelist in /app/frontend/src/lib/investmentAnalytics.js so product_inquiry_open/select carry attribution
Fix bonus badge copy for tagesgeld/flexgeld — BBVA summary talks about Festgeld; add product-specific short copy or truncate
Guard sparkline path generation against empty/failed stock-history data (avoid d="undefined" console errors); investigate supabase functions/v1/stock-history 401
critical_code_review_comments: investmentAnalytics.trackInvestmentEvent drops any prop not in its hardcoded whitelist — every new event dimension (source/product) silently disappears; make the whitelist per-event or extend it.
HomeProductWizardSection renders BANK_BONUS_COPY[...].summary (full paragraph) directly into a card badge; add a dedicated short field in bankBonusTexts.js for badge usage.

ProductInquiryStickyCta calls getProductCatalog() at module scope (line 36) while HomeProductWizardSection calls it per render — fine functionally, but inconsistent; consider memoizing a single frozen catalog export.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 requested feature checks passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Consent gate: select_option DE on [data-testid=visitor-residence], 'privatperson' on [data-testid=visitor-role], then click [data-testid=visitor-accept-btn]. Impression tracking is once-per-session via sessionStorage key 'product_wizard_inline_open_fired'; to retest, use a fresh context or clear sessionStorage. Analytics can be asserted by wrapping window.dataLayer.push. Known non-blockers: supabase stock-history 401 + resulting SVG path 'undefined' errors, Supabase constraint for fonds/tagesgeld/festgeld/flexgeld wizard submit (external).
rca_of_the_issue: No regression found for the refactoring. Root cause of the missing analytics dimensions: investmentAnalytics.js sanitizes props against a fixed key whitelist that excludes 'source' and 'product', so the events fire without payload. Root cause of the misleading badge: PRODUCT_BONUS_SOURCE maps tagesgeld/flexgeld to bbva-bank-deutschland whose BANK_BONUS_COPY.summary is Festgeld-specific.
